environment: React 19 in Happy DOM, isolated storage; not a real browser or layout engine

checks.check: Initial: five fields, booster options open per user preference, no selected booster
Empty submission: error shown and focused, no dialog
Five fields update the existing local draft format
Estensore: ten fields and selected summary
Collapse/reopen preserves all ten words and booster
Reordering position 10 upwards changes order and follows focus
5su10: ten words retained, one selected booster
Ten-word summary includes ten ordered words and 5su10
Confirm DEMO stores independent receipt without changing data format
Closing confirmation restores focus to review action
Later edits remain a draft and preserve the previous receipt
Previous receipt shows original words and explains unconfirmed changes
Cancel removal preserves ten active fields and booster
Remove booster returns to five fields, retains hidden words and warns
Jolly remains a five-word booster
Top replaces Jolly and retains five words
Wrong initial is rejected
Duplicate is rejected
Locution is rejected
Five-word summary remains available after returning from ten
Five-word confirmation replaces the receipt without deleting hidden draft words
